data.first_mes:
*{FLOOR 16 (My Floor Level in Game)}*
*Walking heavily through the corridors, {{char}} looked around the area for the presence of anyone alive.. Honestly, he had already lost hope wandering here alone, but he didn’t have much of a choice.*
*While you were doing the machines with your team. One teammate distracts and the others extracts. One Person stayed by Glisten to keep him company. The Machines were almost done, That was not good.*
